jobs.description:
Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

Your responsibilities as a Reach Truck Operator include:

 
• 
Carrying out inspections and checks on incoming and outgoing goods.

 
• 
Placing incoming products in the correct locations within the warehouse and preparing outgoing goods for shipment.

 
• 
Scanning products into the system once they have been stored in the appropriate location.

 
• 
Primarily operating a reach truck, while also being comfortable using a forklift truck and pallet truck when required.

Interested? Read on to find out if you qualify!

 
• 
You are ready to work in the fixed nightshift.

 
• 
You hold a valid reach truck certificate.

 
• 
You already have some experience operating a reach truck. Stacking goods up to 10 meters high does not intimidate you.

 
• 
You are able to communicate in English with your colleagues.

 
• 
You will be working in a frozen warehouse at -18°C, operating an enclosed, heated reach truck. Appropriate protective clothing will also be provided by the company.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packs and stores frozen and refrigerated food products for numerous European companies. They do this for each customer. By 2027, the company aims to have 300+ employees working on 25 000 unique packaging assignments. Working in this company means working in a respectful environment, where a great bond between employees and dedication to work go hand in hand.

As a Quality Controller, you work closely with the quality and production teams to ensure that our products not only meet the strictest standards, but also end up on store shelves with pride.

 
• 
80% inspections on the workfloor/production <> 20% desk work (registration/documentation of performed checks)

 
• 
Visual inspections of packaging and labeling

 
• 
Monitoring quality standards and improving them where possible

 
• 
Providing support during audits or certifications (BRC, IFS, Organic, customer audits...)

 
• 
Coaching among employees to strengthen quality awareness

Does reading this set of responsibilities already spark your interest? Read on and find out what we expect from you:

 
• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience in a food production environment

 
• 
Experience with BRC and IFS standards

 
• 
A good knowledge of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate smoothly with colleagues

 
• 
You have a critical mindset and a strong eye for detail

 
• 
Your insights and observations contribute to maintaining and improving the quality level of our products

 
• 
You are willing to work in a cold environment (5–10 °C), including about half an hour per day performing checks in the freezer (-18 °C)

 
• 
You are comfortable working with MS Office and Outlook

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You oversee the production process and, together with your team, ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

 
• 
You monitor the operation of 3 automatic packaging machines

 
• 
You manage 3 operators and 2 forklift drivers and provide guidance throughout their work

 
• 
You actively work on the machines yourself and step in wherever needed

 
• 
You set up, monitor, and adjust the packaging machines

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, safety, efficiency, and production planning

 
• 
You carry out checks on products and packaging

 
• 
You identify malfunctions and deviations and resolve them yourself whenever possible

 
• 
You ensure an efficient distribution of tasks and clear communication within the team

 
• 
You are the first point of contact for employees on the production floor

Do you know automatic packaging lines inside out, enjoy taking a hands-on approach, and at the same time know how to keep an overview of both your team and the production process? Then this Team Leader position could be a great fit for you.

 
• 
Experience working with an automatic packaging line is essential

 
• 
You have strong technical insight and a hands-on mentality

 
• 
Experience with CPS, multihead weighers, checkweighers, metal detection systems and/or automatic stackers is an advantage

 
• 
Experience managing or coordinating a team is an asset

 
• 
You have natural leadership skills and the maturity required to take responsibility

 
• 
You have good organisational and communication skills

 
• 
You communicate very well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is essential, as you will be managing operators and forklift drivers who speak Dutch, English, or French

This vacancy is exclusively intended for direct candidates. Selection, interim, and recruitment agencies are kindly requested to refrain from contacting us.
 

Boury is a three-Michelin-starred restaurant with international recognition for its precision, refinement, and uncompromising quality standards. Our kitchen operates at the highest level of contemporary gastronomy, where craftsmanship, discipline, and perfection are at the heart of everything we do.
 

We are looking for an experienced, structured, and creative baker. In this role, you will be responsible for the daily production of bread and bakery products at the highest gastronomic level. You will work closely with the kitchen team to ensure consistency, quality, and flawless execution, directly contributing to the overall guest experience.
 

Your responsibilities include:
 
 

• Preparing and baking artisan breads and bakery products according to Boury’s quality standards; 

• Managing the daily mise en place and production planning for bakery products; 

• Contributing to a professional, disciplined, and team-oriented working environment; 

• Continuously striving for improvement in techniques, efficiency, and quality. 
 

• You have at least 2 years of relevant professional experience within a high-quality bakery or gastronomic environment. 

• You have a genuine passion and interest in products, craftsmanship, and the continuous pursuit of excellence. 

• You are motivated to work at the highest gastronomic level and have an eye for detail, consistency, and quality. 

• You are comfortable working during weekends and understand the commitment required within a top-level culinary environment. 

• Due to the international nature of our team, you are able to communicate effectively in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus. 

• You are a team-oriented professional with a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and a willingness to continuously improve your techniques and contribute to the team.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

Are you looking for a great logistics job on the day shift? Be sure to read on!

What will you be handling as a forklift operator?

 
• 
You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

 
• 
You'll be responsible for delivering products to be packaged to the packaging department

 
• 
You scan labels and locations correctly into the system

 
• 
During your work, you ensure a smooth and organised flow of goods

 
• 
You hold a valid forklift certificate

 
• 
You have at least 2 years' experience as a forklift operator, including working at height

 
• 
You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

 
• 
Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

 
• 
Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you

• International Automotive Company with office Brussels and Antwerp
• French Speaking environment
Client Details

For an international company active in the automotive sector, we are looking for a passionate and proactive Communication Officer. The company specializes in innovative vehicle solutions and operates across several international markets.

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description
Your responsibilities
• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile
• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

jobs.occupation: German Business developer | 100% on site in Antwerp
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international company operating in the food industry. Combining the mindset of a family business with strong entrepreneurial ambitions, they offer a dynamic and fast-paced working environment where initiative, commercial drive and results are highly valued.To support their continued international growth, they are looking for a German-speaking Business Developer to further develop the German market.This position is 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As a German Business Developer, you will play an active role in expanding the company's presence in Germany. You will have the opportunity to build your own network, develop new business and create long-term customer relationships.Your responsibilities include:

• Proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities within the German market.
• Reaching out to potential customers and opening new commercial doors.
• Building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships with customers and prospects.
• Managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and closing deals.
• Following up on commercial opportunities and developing your customer portfolio.
• Monitoring the German market and identifying new trends and opportunities.
• Tracking sales activities and results.
• Contributing ideas and market insights to the broader commercial strategy.

We are looking for someone with commercial drive, ambition and the motivation to make things happen. Previous experience is welcome, but your mindset and potential are just as important.

• You are fluent in German and English. Knowledge of Dutch or another language is a strong asset.
• Previous experience in sales, business development or another commercial role is a plus, but definitely not a must.
• Motivated junior candidates and recent graduates are very welcome to apply. If you are eager to learn, commercially minded and excited by the idea of developing a market, we would love to hear from you.
• You are proactive and enjoy approaching new prospects and creating opportunities.
• You have strong communication and relationship-building skills.
• You are commercially minded and motivated by achieving results.
• You are a real go-getter who is not afraid to take initiative.
• You are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• An affinity with the food industry is an advantage, but not required.
• A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience is a plus.
• You are happy to work 100% on-site in Antwerp.

Are you an Inside Sales Representative with experience in the food industry and strong language skills in English plus German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese? Apply today and join an international trading environment.Your role as an Inside Sales RepresentativeFor an international company active in the food sector, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and expand commercial relationships within the meat industry. As a Sales Support Specialist and Internal Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships and ensuring smooth follow-up of the entire sales process.Your responsibilities: 
• Manage and develop an existing customer portfolio. 
• Prepare, send and follow up on quotations. 
• Maintain regular contact with restaurants, hotels and retail customers. 
• Identify commercial opportunities and support business growth. 
• Coordinate customer requests and monitor deliveries. 
• Participate in trade fairs and industry events when required. 
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and international partners.
Your profile as an Inside Sales Representative / Internal Account Manager 
• You have experience in an inside sales, sales support, customer service or commercial administration role. 
• Experience in the food industry. 
• Experience within the meat sector is considered a significant advantage. 
• You communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese. 
• You have experience with customer follow-up, quotation management and commercial administration. 
• You are comfortable working with common office software and digital systems. 
• You are willing to attend trade fairs on an occasional basis.

As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

We are currently looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist, fluent in French and English, to join a team based in Brussels.

In this temporary assignment, you will play a key role in supporting the full recruitment cycle within the professional services sector. Your responsibilities will include sourcing talent, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and ensuring an efficient and positive hiring process.

Client Details

A professional services organisation based in Brussels.

Description

As a recruiter your responsibilities are:

 

• Source and attract candidates using various recruitment channels.
• Screen and shortlist applicants based on job requirements.
• Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers.
• Maintain and update recruitment databases and records.
• Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
• Provide support in contract preparation and onboarding processes.
• Collaborate with the HR team to meet recruitment goals.
• Ensure compliance with recruitment policies and procedures

• Bilingual in French and English (mandatory)
• Previous experience in recruitment is required
• Enjoys daily interaction with people while also appreciating administrative tasks
• Available immediately
• Temporary contract, with a potential opportunity for a permanent position

Our client is a well-established international industrial manufacturing company with production facilities in Belgium and abroad. The company is recognised for its strong market position and continuous focus on innovation, customer service and operational excellence.

Jobomschrijving

As Supply Chain Manager you will:

• Lead a Supply Chain organisation of 90 fte (of which 6 direct reports) covering demand planning, customer service and transportation planning.
• Develop and enhance forecasting and demand planning processes to improve service levels, forecast accuracy and business performance.
• Define, implement and monitor relevant Supply Chain KPI's and SLA frameworks to support scalable growth.
• Drive customer segmentation initiatives and align differentiated service levels with planning and supply strategies.
• Support the introduction of new product ranges while contributing to product portfolio rationalisation initiatives.

A successful Supply Chain Manager should have:

• Practical capability in coordinating supply chain activities.
• Experience with planning material and product flows.
• Ability to monitor supply chain information and act on operational priorities.
• Knowledge of procurement and supply chain processes.
• Ability to maintain accurate data for planning and follow-up.
• Confidence working with internal stakeholders on supply chain coordination.
• Collaborate closely with stakeholders including Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations and ICT teams to ensure end-to-end supply chain alignment.
• Lead, coach and develop a team of 6 direct reports and approximately 90 indirect reports.
• A good professional level of Dutch and English.

Robert Half is currently looking for a Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist (m/f/x) for a permanent position.

 

Our client is an international company located in Groot-Bijgaarden.

 

As a Cost Accounting, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and ensuring accurate cost tracking.
• Processing and reviewing invoices while maintaining accurate accounting records.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations and journal entries.
• Assisting with budgeting, forecasting and financial analysis.
• Preparing financial reports and supporting internal and external audits.
• Contributing to process improvements and ensuring compliance with internal procedures.
 

The required qualifications for this position of Cost Accounting & Reporting Specialist are:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent through experience.
• You have at least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Experience within the Services or Retail sector is required.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of French, German or other European languages is considered an asset.
• You have advanced Excel skills and experience working with SAP. Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.
• Experience in an international or shared service environment and knowledge of IFRS are considered strong assets.

• 
Lead, coach and develop a team of Finance Operations professionals.

• 
Ensure the accurate and timely processing of purchase orders.

• 
Maintain the quality and integrity of vendor master data while ensuring compliance with financial controls.

•

3+ years in financial management/leadership; experience with system-driven procurement processes.

For a leading US company with its European headquarters in Brussels, we are looking for an Accounting Specialist. You will join an international environment where Finance, Operations, HR, Tax, and Real Estate work closely together. This role exists to ensure that accounting and reporting processes across multiple markets are carried out accurately and on time. We are looking for someone who is analytically strong, communicates fluently, and feels comfortable in a dynamic and collaborative culture.

Your responsibilities

• 
Coordinate the administration of invoices and obligations related to leasing, housekeeping, payroll, property taxes, and travel expenses.

• 
Monitor budgets and analyze deviations in recurring costs and monthly closings.

• 
Oversee reconciliations, intercompany positions, and payroll reconciliations.

Prepare VAT, property tax, and other tax filings in collaboration with the Tax department.

• 
Support external audits, year-end closing, and the preparation of statutory financial statements.

• 
Assist in the integration of new or acquired stores into accounting processes.

• 
Contribute to ESG data collection, budget preparation, and process improvements.

• 
Support and coach team members and new colleagues where necessary.

Your profile

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.

At least 5 years of experience in accounting.

Experience with financial statements, IFRS, and local GAAP.

• 
Experience in services or retail is required.

• 
Experience with SAP; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is a plus.

• 
Experience with ERP/CRM migrations and UAT is an advantage.

• 
Fluent in English and French; German is a strong plus.

• 
Strong skills in Excel and Microsoft Office.

• 
Accurate, independent, communicative, and solution-oriented.

Join a team dedicated to healthcare interoperability, developing services that connect our Enterprise Imaging platform with hospital information systems and other clinical applications. Your work will help ensure that medical imaging and patient information can be shared efficiently across healthcare ecosystems, supporting better clinical workflows and patient care. 
 
• develop and maintain software components within our Enterprise Imaging platform,
